name: print-social-maio-amarelo-drive-safely-post-black-yellow-portrait
title: 'Maio Amarelo' road safety post with a black-yellow diagonal band and a serious male portrait
whatItIs: A black square post with a thin white wireframe square overlay, a yellow diagonal geometric band cutting across the top-right, a bold Portuguese headline 'Dirigir com Responsabilidade e Consciência salva vidas!', a yellow chevron-arrow tag with a checkmark shield icon, and a serious close-up portrait of a man lit from the side.
whatItMeans: Serious and credible; stark black-yellow contrast and direct portrait lighting suit a road-safety awareness message.
techniques: Cut a bold colour band diagonally across a dark photo.
Light a portrait dramatically from one side for gravity.
Use a shield-and-check icon to signal safety and trust.

vocabulary.definition: An angled colour or shape cutting across a composition.
Light falling from one side to add drama to a portrait.
